deliverability.title: Deliverability toolkit

encryption.title: Encryption at rest

product.title: One platform, from inbox to infrastructure

webmail.title: A webmail your team will actually enjoy

webmail.bullet3: Snooze, schedule send and rich signatures

admin.title: Run your whole organization from one dashboard

security.title: Deliverability and security, handled for you

security.bullet4: 2FA enforcement and full access audit logs

testimonials.title: Loved by teams who rely on email
testimonials.description: From two-person startups to organizations with hundreds of mailboxes, teams trust MailGo to keep their email fast, secure and delivered.

one.quote: We migrated 400 mailboxes to MailGo over a weekend and never looked back. Deliverability jumped and our support tickets about email all but disappeared.

two.quote: The webmail is genuinely fast. Our team stopped asking for a desktop client within a week.

three.quote: SPF, DKIM and DMARC were configured for us automatically. That alone saved me a full day of DNS work.

four.quote: Provisioning a new joiner's mailbox takes seconds. The admin dashboard is exactly what we wanted.

five.quote: Inbox placement analytics finally give us visibility we never had with our previous provider.
